W.note: Clean dark card with a badge and summary line, but the open state is tall because the add form is always visible, and the open/close snaps with no transition.

X.note: The most complete tracker (dated steps, expected windows, exception actions, snooze, carrier, tracking number) with a smooth grid-height open, but the collapsed stack with a notice bar and two close marks is busy and the open panel is tall.

Y.note: Smallest footprint at rest and when open, with a smooth panel ease, checkmarked steps, aria-expanded and a live region; it lacks a standing next-step line outside an exception.

Z.note: A strong one-line summary and a useful multi-package list with progress bars and tags, but the panel appears at full height with no transition and tracking numbers are masked.
